description: Shared material catalog: wall, floor and ceiling finishes, furniture and rug materials. Built-in textures are procedural (src/home/three/textures.ts), no external files. EVERY texture has a real pattern repeat size (physicalSize): a 0.60 × 0.60 m tile covers exactly 0.60 × 0.60 m of the surface (surface UVs are in metres).

conventions.physicalSize: [width, height] of one texture repeat in metres (tiles: tile module; boards: [board length, board width × pattern rows])
conventions.textureSet: texture description: type solid | tiles | planks | panels | fluted | slats | wallpaper | noise | weave | terrazzo | rug; pattern parameters; type 'file' (PBR maps from files) — prepared for external materials
conventions.surfaces: where the material can be used: wall, floor, ceiling, furniture, rug
conventions.normalScale: relief strength (bump map from the same texture; 0 = flat)
